name: ADS-B Exchange
tagline: Crowdsourced ADS-B aircraft tracking and flight data API
description: ADS-B Exchange provides real-time and historical aircraft tracking data from a global network of ADS-B receivers. Developers can query live positions, aircraft details, and related flight information via a REST API for aviation apps, logistics, and research.

auth.details: API key required; obtain via paid subscription or data access program (verify current signup path on official site)

use_cases: get aircraft currently near a lat/lon
look up a flight by callsign or ICAO hex
track live aircraft positions for a map
filter aircraft by altitude or distance
